item.title: 2. Proving nothing changed
item.description:
Siemens and NVIDIA's agent-run 3D-IC thermal workflow, Cadence's sovereign AI platform and Nokia's 5x claim, VerifierBench on AI-written checkers, an explainer on equivalence checking, and a verification corner on why 100% coverage isn't proof the data was right.

Sources:

  • Siemens, NVIDIA expand agentic AI collaboration for 3D IC power and thermal design (I-Connect007)
  • Siemens and Nvidia automate thermal analyses in chip design (All About Industries)
  • Siemens Fuse EDA AI Agent press release (Siemens)
  • Cadence announces sovereign AI cloud for chip design (Forbes, Karl Freund; author discloses Cadence and NVIDIA as clients)
  • Nokia designs network hardware 5x faster on Cadence's agentic supercomputer (Futurum)
  • VerifierBench: Benchmarking the Generation of Executable Verifiers for LLM Agents (arXiv)
  • Formal equivalence checking (Wikipedia)
  • Using Speculation for Sequential Equivalence Checking (Brayton, Een, Mishchenko, UC Berkeley)
  • Independent Data-Integrity Verification for LLM-Driven Functional Coverage Closure in Hardware Design (arXiv)
  • Cadence announces third quarter 2026 financial results webcast (Finviz)
  • Cadence to release Q3 earnings: will AI momentum drive growth? (Yahoo Finance / Zacks)

Researched and written by Claude; voiced with synthetic speech.

item.title: 1. Spec to layout: how far can agents get?
item.description:
GPT-Synopsys, NVIDIA's chip-design partners at SEMICON West, Rambus going company-wide with ChipAgents, a deep dive on Build-A-Chip Bench, and a verification corner on why a passing tool isn't proof of intent.

Sources:

  • OpenAI and Synopsys announce GPT-Synopsys (AnySilicon)
  • NVIDIA and semiconductor leaders advance AI across chip design and manufacturing (GlobeNewswire)
  • Chip Industry Week In Review, Oct 23 (Semiconductor Engineering)
  • ChipAgents expands Series A to $134 million (Unite.AI)
  • Socionext expands agentic AI to large-scale SoC physical design (Finviz)
  • Build-A-Chip Bench results (ChipAgents)
  • ChipAgents and NVIDIA put autonomous chip design to the test (SemiWiki)
  • A Survey on LLM-Integrated Hardware Design Verification (arXiv)

Researched and written by Claude; voiced with synthetic speech.
